name: Choose an internet plan from the pricing page
description: Verifies all four Ghana cedi packages are visible and a visitor can select a plan.
steps: Open the CommunityNet home page on mobile
expected: The GHS 15 three-day plan is visibly selected and the page explains that payment and router access require live configuration.

name: Open the customer login portal
description: Verifies a customer can open the login form and cannot submit empty credentials.
steps: Leave the phone or username and password fields empty
expected: A validation message appears and no internet-access success is shown.

name: Open administrator setup controls
description: Verifies setup status is clearly presented without pretending unconfigured services are connected.
expected: Router and payment integrations are marked as awaiting configuration, with no false connected or paid status.

name: Display plan duration and price accurately
description: Verifies each package displays the specified price and duration.
steps: Check the daily, three-day, seven-day, and monthly options
expected: The page shows GH₵10 for 24 hours, GH₵15 for 3 days, GH₵35 for 7 days, and GH₵150 for 30 days.
